newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway c.bank sets 3.7 pct fixed-term deposit rate.
newsitem.headline: Norway c.bank sets 3.7 pct fixed-term deposit rate.

text.p: Norway's central bank, Norges Bank, said on Wednesday it had set an interest rate of 3.70 percent for its fixed-term deposit rate for the period July 3 to July 7.
On Tuesday the bank announced an interest rate of 3.6 percent for its fixed-term deposit rate between July 1 and July 3 and an interest rate of 3.7 percent for the period July 2 to July 7.
It is the fourth time within a week that the bank has announced a fixed interest rate.
Norges Bank regularly announces fixed-term deposits or fixed-term loans, which usually are carried out through ordinary auction, in order to control money market liquidity.
